builds.d: A build that steadily stacks Sweep Marks to unleash Ultimate Phase 2 and deal higher DMG.
A build that stacks Sweep Marks to cast Ultimate Phase 1 while boosting Auto Attacks and Marks.

l.b: In an all-Aqua squad, increases the maximum number of Sweep Marks. They no longer disappear over time, and each Sweep Mark additionally increases Allie's Crit Rate. When the number of lit ⟨Sweep Mark⟩ reaches the maximum, Ultimate Phase 2 can be cast via the Main Skill.
l.s: In an all-Aqua squad, increases the maximum number of Sweep Marks to ⟦0⟧. They no longer disappear over time, and each Sweep Mark additionally increases Allie's Crit Rate by ⟦1⟧. When the number of lit ⟨Sweep Mark⟩ reaches the maximum, Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2) can be cast via the Main Skill.

l.b: When casting Auto Attacks or Main Skill, generates a blade shadow that deals AoE Aqua DMG and gains Sweep Mark.
l.s: When casting Housework Slash (Auto Attack) or Sweeping Rush (Main Skill), generates a blade shadow that deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG, and gains 1 Sweep Mark. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

l.b: For a period of time after casting Ultimate Phase 2, the trigger interval of blade shadow is reduced. In an all-Aqua squad, increases Allie's Skill Crit Rate and Skill Crit DMG.
l.s: For the next ⟦0⟧s after casting Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2), the trigger interval of blade shadow is reduced to ⟦1⟧s. This effect can be triggered only once every 15s. In an all-Aqua squad, increases Allie's Skill Crit Rate by ⟦2⟧ and Skill Crit DMG by ⟦3⟧.

l.b: All DMG dealt by Ultimate Phase 2 becomes Skill DMG. When casting Ultimate Phase 2 or the Main Skill, increases own Skill DMG.
l.s: All Ultimate DMG dealt by Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2) becomes Skill DMG. When casting Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2) or Sweeping Rush (Main Skill), increases own Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: When gaining a Sweep Mark, increases the Skill DMG dealt by the Main Skill and Multi Sweep (Potential).
l.s: When gaining a Sweep Mark, increases the Skill DMG dealt by Sweeping Rush (Main Skill) and Multi Sweep (Potential) by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: When the number of lit Sweep Marks reaches the maximum, Ultimate Phase 1 can be cast via the Main Skill. Casting Ultimate Phase 1 by any means consumes all Sweep Marks and grants max stacks of Sweep Mark buffs.
l.s: When the number of lit Sweep Marks reaches the maximum, Deep Sweep: Dust Off (Ultimate Phase 1) can be cast via the Main Skill. Casting Ultimate Phase 1 by any means consumes all Sweep Marks and grants max stacks of Sweep Mark buffs. Cannot gain Sweep Marks while Sweeping Stance is active.

l.b: While Sweeping Stance of Ultimate Phase 1 is active, additionally increases Allie's Mark DMG. While Sweeping Stance is active, when the target's Tide reaches a certain number of stacks, additionally generates a Wave. Wave is enhanced to ⟨Abyssal Wave⟩.
l.s: While Sweeping Stance of Deep Sweep: Dust Off (Ultimate Phase 1) is active, additionally increases Allie's Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧. Meanwhile, when Allie triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ to generate ⟨Tide⟩, if the target's Tide stacks reach ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, additionally generates a Wave. Wave is enhanced to ⟨Abyssal Wave⟩: deals ⟦3⟧ of ATK as AoE Mark DMG.

l.b: Increases Allie's Auto Attack DMG. In an all-Aqua squad and while Sweeping Stance is active, Housework Slash (Auto Attack) is enhanced, increasing its DMG multiplier. It can also trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ to generate ⟨Tide⟩.
l.s: Increases Allie's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. In an all-Aqua squad and while Sweeping Stance is active, Housework Slash (Auto Attack) is enhanced, increasing its DMG multiplier by ⟦1⟧. It can also trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ to generate ⟨Tide⟩.

l.b: In an all-Aqua squad, all DMG dealt by Ultimate Phase 1 and Auto Attacks becomes Mark DMG. Meanwhile, increasing Allie's Auto Attack DMG additionally increases her Mark DMG. Reduces Allie's Mark Crit Rate.
l.s: In an all-Aqua squad, all DMG dealt by Deep Sweep: Dust Off (Ultimate Phase 1) and Housework Slash (Auto Attack) becomes Mark DMG. Meanwhile, every 1.3% increase in Auto Attack DMG additionally increases Allie's Mark DMG by 1%, up to ⟦0⟧. Reduces Allie's Mark Crit Rate by 100%.

l.b: While Sweeping Stance is active, generating Wave via ⟨Tide⟩ a certain number of times grants 1 stack of Pending Chore and increases Allie's Auto Attack DMG. Upon exiting Sweeping Stance, Pending Chores are converted into Sweep Marks.
l.s: While Sweeping Stance is active, every ⟦0⟧ times Wave is generated via ⟨Tide⟩, grants 1 stack of Pending Chore, up to 4 stacks. Meanwhile, increases Allie's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 9s, up to 3 stacks. Upon exiting Sweeping Stance, each stack of Pending Chore is converted into 1 Sweep Mark.

l.b: A period of time after holding Dodge to dash, immediately gains 3 Sweep Marks. For each Aqua Trekker in the squad, increases Allie's Aqua DMG.
l.s: 0.5s after holding Dodge to dash, immediately gains 3 Sweep Marks. This effect can be triggered once every 120s. For each Aqua Trekker in the squad, increases Allie's Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When dodging or gaining a Shield, increases Allie's ATK.
l.s: When dodging or gaining a Shield, increases Allie's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: When Allie deals Mark DMG, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Allie deals Mark DMG, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, boosts stats.
l.s: When casting Deep Sweep (Ultimate), increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, up to 2 stacks.

l.b: Increases the burst range and DMG of Ultimate Phase 1.
l.s: Increases the burst range of Deep Sweep: Dust Off (Ultimate Phase 1) by ⟦0⟧, and increases its DMG multiplier dealt by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Ultimate Phase 2 creates an additional long blade phantom that deals DMG. Increases Ultimate Phase 2's DMG multiplier dealt.
l.s: Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2) creates an additional long blade phantom that deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Ultimate DMG. Increases Ultimate Phase 2's DMG multiplier dealt by ⟦1⟧.

builds.d: A build focused on boosting Cycling Slashes and casting Frost Blades.
A build focused on boosting Finishing Slashes and ice crystals.

l.b: Cycling Slashes fires Frost Blades, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG multiple times.
l.s: Cycling Slashes fires Frost Blades, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG multiple times.

l.b: Cycling Slashes can deal more hits, and its Aqua DMG dealt is increased.
l.s: Cycling Slashes can deal ⟦0⟧ more hits, and its Aqua DMG dealt is increased by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The longer Allie is on the battlefield, the higher the Skill DMG she deals.
l.s: For every 0.5s Allie is on the battlefield, increases her Skill DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: Additionally increases the Skill DMG dealt by Cycling Slashes. It is further increased against targets with ⟨Resilience Break⟩.
l.s: Additionally increases the Skill DMG dealt by Cycling Slashes by ⟦0⟧. It is further increased by ⟦1⟧ against targets with ⟨Resilience Break⟩.

l.b: When Cycling Slashes hits more than 3 targets, increases its Aqua DMG dealt.
l.s: When Cycling Slashes hits more than 3 targets, increases its Aqua DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Finishing Slash deals additional AoE Aqua Skill DMG.
l.s: Finishing Slash deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: The ice crystals formed by Finishing Slash will explode, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG again.
l.s: The ice crystals formed by Finishing Slash will explode, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG again.

l.b: Increases the range of ice crystals. Finishing Slash generates more ice crystals, each dealing Aqua AoE Skill DMG.
l.s: Increases the range of ice crystals. Finishing Slash generates 2 more ice crystals, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Aqua AoE Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Finishing Slash and ice crystals. It is additionally increased against elite or higher-tier targets.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Finishing Slash and ice crystals by ⟦0⟧. It is additionally increased by ⟦1⟧ against elite or higher-tier targets.

l.b: When Finishing Slash and ice crystals hit fewer than 4 targets, increases their Aqua DMG dealt.
l.s: When Finishing Slash and ice crystals hit fewer than 4 targets, increases their Aqua DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: In an all-Aqua squad, boosts the squad's stats.
l.s: In an all-Aqua squad, boosts the squad's Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When a Support Trekker is on the battlefield, increases Aqua DMG dealt by Allie.
l.s: When a Support Trekker is on the battlefield, increases Aqua DMG dealt by Allie by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Allie's Aqua DMG.
l.s: Increases Allie's Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, boosts stats.
l.s: When casting Deep Sweep (Ultimate), increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, up to 2 stacks.

l.b: Increases the burst range and DMG of Ultimate Phase 1.
l.s: Increases the burst range of Deep Sweep: Dust Off (Ultimate Phase 1) by ⟦0⟧, and increases its DMG multiplier dealt by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Ultimate Phase 2 creates an additional long blade phantom that deals DMG. Increases Ultimate Phase 2's DMG multiplier dealt.
l.s: Deep Sweep: Restore Order (Ultimate Phase 2) creates an additional long blade phantom that deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Ultimate DMG. Increases Ultimate Phase 2's DMG multiplier dealt by ⟦1⟧.
